title: UNIFI Communications Acquires WIS Telecom to Accelerate Growth of UNIFI's Global Carrier Business
主要内容: UNIFI Communications acquired WIS Telecom S.p.A. and its subsidiary, WIS Telecom S.A., from Libero Acquisition S.a.r.l., an investment vehicle of Orascom TMT Investments S.à r.l. ("OTMTI"), majority-owned by Mr. Naguib Sawris of Cairo, Egypt. The acquisition is expected to create synergies by combining similar core businesses, networks, geographic coverage, and customers, expanding UNIFI's footprint, reducing operating costs, and improving service quality in the wholesale voice market. WIS is ranked as the 15th largest international carrier by Telegeography, providing international voice, data, and IP solutions to fixed and mobile operators. The acquisition aligns with UNIFI's strategy to divest non-core assets and focus on key operations. WIS Telecom, headquartered in Rome, Italy, operates primarily in South and Eastern Europe and the MENA region, where it is a leader in international telecom services.
